title: iberis ciliata var. senneniana
intro: Iberis ciliata var. senneniana, commonly known as Alpine Rock-cress, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving immune function, due to its anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Iberis ciliata var. senneniana include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
